items.stem:
This study app allows users to track and manage their tasks more effectively, it uses a database table TASKS to store information on different tasks.
TASKS
Field name
Description
TID
Identity code of each task
TNAME
Name of the task
DESCRIPTION
Description of the task
PRIORITY
Priority level of the task (1 means high; 2 means medium; 3 means low)
STATUS
Status of the task (1 means In progress; 0 means completed)
DURATION
Duration of the task in minutes, this field could be null if the task has not been completed
(a)
Write a SQL command to select all tasks’ names and descriptions in the TASKS table with a high priority level and currently in progress. (2 marks)
(b)
Write a SQL command to calculate the total duration of all tasks. (2 marks)
(c)
Ginny would like to find out all her tasks or descriptions including the word 'maths'. Write a SQL command to accomplish her task. (2 marks)
(d)
Suppose there is a table named ADMIN that the developing team can view all users’ activities. Below are some records of this table.
ADMIN
UID
UNAME
TID
001
Allison Fung
T01
001
Allison Fung
T02

Lisa Ma
T03
003
Clarissa Tong
T04
003
Clarissa Tong
T05
003
Clarissa Tong
T06
(i)
What is the primary key of ADMIN? (1 mark)____________________________________________________________________________
(ii)
Write a SQL command to count the number of tasks associated with each user in the ADMIN table who has set more than or equal to 3 tasks. (2 marks)
[--Answer:
(a) SELECT TNAME, DESCRIPTION
FROM TASKS
WHERE PRIORITY = 1 AND STATUS = 1
(b) SELECT SUM(DURATION) AS TOTAL_DURATION
FROM TASKS
WHERE DURATION IS NOT NULL
(c) SELECT TNAME, DESCRIPTION
FROM TASKS
WHERE TNAME LIKE '%maths%' OR DESCRIPTION LIKE '%maths%'
(d)
(i) UID+TID
(ii) SELECT UID, COUNT(*)
FROM ADMIN
GROUP BY UID
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
--]
